title: Human biology
learning_outcomes: Explain cells and tissues in the context of human biology.
Compare and distinguish circulation and respiration in the context of human biology.
Apply digestion and kidneys in the context of human biology.
Evaluate and justify decisions about homeostasis in the context of human biology.

lessons.title: Cells and tissues
lessons.outcome: Explain cells and tissues in the context of human biology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cells and tissues; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to organ-system diagram.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cells and tissues from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cells and tissues; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Circulation and respiration
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish circulation and respiration in the context of human biology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving circulation and respiration; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to organ-system diagram.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain circulation and respiration from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of circulation and respiration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Digestion and kidneys
lessons.outcome: Apply digestion and kidneys in the context of human biology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving digestion and kidneys; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to organ-system diagram.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain digestion and kidneys from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of digestion and kidneys; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Homeostasis
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about homeostasis in the context of human biology.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving homeostasis; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to organ-system diagram.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain homeostasis from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of homeostasis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of cells and tissues; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of circulation and respiration; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of digestion and kidneys; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of homeostasis; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
